verdict.rationale: Kommo documents a constructor for automatic system reactions to events such as lead stage changes and website visits. It also offers workflow automation and a SalesBot visual editor, so trigger-based workflows are a first-party capability. However, the evidence never shows the specific actions the story asks for: updating records, creating tasks, or sending notifications. Missing for 10: documented record-update actions, task-creation actions, notification actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the workflow builder.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can build trigger-based workflows that update records, create tasks, and send notifications automatically

citations.quote: The constructor enables you to set up automatic system reactions for events such as lead stage changes and website visits.
integrators can create their own event handlers and add them to the list of available automatic actions.
